title: Authentication Bypass via JSON/HTTP Parser Differentials

technique.summary: Exploit parser disagreements in multi-tier architectures (proxy/gateway + backend) to bypass authentication. When two JSON parsers handle duplicate keys differently (first-wins vs last-wins), or two HTTP layers handle duplicate headers differently, an attacker can present different identities to the authorization layer vs the processing layer.
steps: Identify multi-tier architecture: reverse proxy, API gateway, WAF, or load balancer in front of application server
Test JSON duplicate keys: send {"role":"user","role":"admin"} — if authorization checks first key but backend uses last, role escalation occurs
Test duplicate HTTP headers: send two Authorization headers via rawHeaders — proxy may check first, backend may use second
Test Content-Type differential: send application/json body with Content-Type text/plain — WAF may skip JSON inspection
Test Unicode key collision: use \u0072ole instead of role — one parser normalizes, the other treats as different key
Confirm differential behavior by observing different responses/access levels

payloads.notes: JSON duplicate key exploit — Python json uses last value, Go encoding/json uses last, some parsers use first
Duplicate Authorization headers via rawHeaders — proxy may validate first, backend may use second
Unicode-escaped key 'role' — some parsers normalize before comparison, others treat as distinct key
Whitespace variation in duplicate key — some parsers trim before dedup, others don't

bypassTechniques: Unicode-escaped JSON keys: \u0072ole instead of role — bypasses key-name matching in authorization layer
Trailing whitespace in header names: 'Authorization ' vs 'Authorization' — proxy may not match
Chunked Transfer-Encoding splitting: fragment JSON body across chunks so proxy sees incomplete JSON
Content-Type mismatch: send JSON body with Content-Type: text/plain to bypass JSON-aware WAF inspection
JSON comments or trailing commas: some parsers accept {"role":"admin",} while strict parsers reject it
Duplicate keys with different casing: {"Role":"user","role":"admin"} — depends on case-sensitivity of each parser
